/*common.coco.selectCommonCoCoBottomOrgCodeMultiPop*/
SELECT COM_CODE AS CODE, COM_NAME_LOC AS TEXT, NVL (B.LIST_PRICE, '') AS LIST_PRICE, NVL (B.UNIT_PRICE, '') AS UNIT_PRICE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = B.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, B.AGENT, B.PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = B.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE_NAME FROM ICOMCMPY A, (SELECT * FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_buyer_item_no} AND AGENT = #{st_agent} AND PROCESS_TYPE = #{st_process_type} AND STATUS <> 'D') B WHERE A.COM_CODE = B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE(+) AND A.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND A.BUSINESS_COND IN ('B', 'M') AND A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer}

/*common.coco.selectCommonCoCoBottomOrgCodeMultiPop_self*/
SELECT COM_CODE AS CODE, COM_NAME_LOC AS TEXT, 0 AS LIST_PRICE, 0 AS UNIT_PRICE, '' AS AGENT_NAME, '' AS PROCESS_TYPE_NAME FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE STATUS IN ('C','R') AND BUSINESS_COND IN ('B','M') AND BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer}
